mapper.sql: id, app_id, app_name, service_id, service_name, ip, hostname, port, language, version, qps, avg_rt, status, in_flow, out_flow, instances, register_time, last_heartbeat_time, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_gw_service WHERE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ${(current - 1) * size}, #{size}

SELECT service_name, SUM(CASE WHEN req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qps, COUNT(*) AS calls, AVG(cost) AS avg_cost, SUM(req_bytes) AS in_bytes, SUM(res_bytes) AS out_bytes FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND) AND service_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY service_name
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS api_count FROM tb_gw_api WHERE deleted = 0 AND service_name IS NOT NULL AND service_name != '' GROUP BY service_name
SELECT FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND service_id = #{serviceId} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.app_id, t.app_name FROM tb_gw_service t JOIN ( SELECT app_id, MAX(id) AS mid FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id != '' GROUP BY app_id ) m ON m.mid = t.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.app_id
SELECT DISTINCT app_id, service_id, service_name FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND service_id IS NOT NULL AND service_id != '' ORDER BY service_id
SELECT DISTINCT language FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND language IS NOT NULL AND language != '' ORDER BY language
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_gw_service (app_id, app_name, service_id, service_name, ip, hostname, port, language, version, qps, avg_rt, status, in_flow, out_flow, instances, register_time, last_heartbeat_time, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{appId}, #{appName}, #{serviceId}, #{serviceName}, #{ip}, #{hostname}, #{port}, #{language}, #{version}, #{qps}, #{avgRt}, #{status}, #{inFlow}, #{outFlow}, #{instances}, #{registerTime}, #{lastHeartbeatTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update:
UPDATE tb_gw_service
app_id = #{appId}, app_name = #{appName}, service_name = #{serviceName}, ip = #{ip}, hostname = #{hostname}, port = #{port}, language = #{language}, version = #{version}, status = #{status}, last_heartbeat_time = #{lastHeartbeatTime}, update_time = #{updateTime},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
